title: NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition
titleEn: NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition
description: NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition is the Nintendo Switch version of the award-winning action RPG. Humanity has fled to the Moon after machine lifeforms overrun Earth, and android soldiers 2B and 9S are sent to reclaim the planet. The edition includes the 3C3C1D119440927 DLC with colosseums and costumes, and the Switch version is officially supported on Switch 2.
